speaker_name: Address by Mr. Iván Duque Márquez
speaker_title: Address by Mr. Iván Duque Márquez, President of the Republic of Colombia

paragraphs.text: President of the General Assembly, Volkan Bozkir,
paragraphs.raw_text: President of the General Assembly, Volkan Bozkir,

paragraphs.text: Secretary-General of the United Nations, António Guterres,
paragraphs.raw_text: Secretary-General of the United Nations, António Guterres,

paragraphs.text: Excellencies, Heads of State and Permanent Representatives,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies, Heads of State and Permanent Representatives,

paragraphs.text: It is once again an honour for me to stand before the General Assembly on behalf of the People of Colombia, especially this year as we commemorate the United Nations seventy-fifth anniversary, which marks a milestone in the decision made by sisterly democratic nations to seek out and create space for common growth.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is once again an honour for me to stand before the General Assembly on 
behalf of the People of Colombia, especially this year as we commemorate the United 
Nations seventy-fifth anniversary, which marks a milestone in the decision made by 
sisterly democratic nations to seek out and create space for common growth.

paragraphs.text: My country has understood the importance of dialogue to overcome obstacles and the urgent need for frank discussion to find common ground. That is why we exemplify a long tradition of participation in multilateral settings.
paragraphs.raw_text:
My country has understood the importance of dialogue to overcome obstacles 
and the urgent need for frank discussion to find common ground. That is why we 
exemplify a long tradition of participation in multilateral settings.

paragraphs.text: For example, we became the thirty-seventh member of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development and will become pro tempore President of the Forum for the Progress and Development of South America and the Pacific Alliance. That demonstrates our commitment to multilateralism and regional commitment to finding joint solutions that, in accordance with the United Nations call on us, will help us ensure that no one is left behind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
For example, we became the thirty-seventh member of the Organization for 
Economic Cooperation and Development and will become pro tempore President 
of the Forum for the Progress and Development of South America and the Pacific 
Alliance. That demonstrates our commitment to multilateralism and regional 
commitment to finding joint solutions that, in accordance with the United Nations 
call on us, will help us ensure that no one is left behind.

paragraphs.text: The increase in the loss of biodiversity is currently one of the major global issues. The current situation has shown us the close relationship between human health and that of ecosystems, the declining state of which is putting our survival as a species at risk.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The increase in the loss of biodiversity is currently one of the major global 
issues. The current situation has shown us the close relationship between human 
health and that of ecosystems, the declining state of which is putting our survival as 
a species at risk.

paragraphs.text: Colombia stands out as the second most biodiverse country in the world with the greatest biodiversity per square kilometre. Colombia enjoys the fact that it accounts for 50 per cent of the world’s páramos within a country that is 30 per cent Amazon rainforest.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Colombia stands out as the second most biodiverse country in the world 
with the greatest biodiversity per square kilometre. Colombia enjoys the fact that it 
accounts for 50 per cent of the world’s páramos within a country that is 30 per cent 
Amazon rainforest.

paragraphs.text: Colombia has achieved an overall reduction of 30.9 million tons of carbon dioxide, while we have been waging an unprecedented battle against deforestation in our country’s history. We therefore consider defending the environment as part of our national security.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Colombia has achieved an overall reduction of 30.9 million tons of carbon 
dioxide, while we have been waging an unprecedented battle against deforestation 
in our country’s history. We therefore consider defending the environment as part of 
our national security.

paragraphs.text: That is how we have reduced deforestation by 19 per cent in the past two years and continue to do so. Through the Artemis project, we are making our decision to turn diversity into a strategic asset a reality, and, accordingly, we have recovered more than 6,000 hectares of our Parques Nacionales Naturales and prevented 23,000 hectares of forest from deforestation, while, at the same time, we are planting more than 35 million trees to bring us closer to our goal of planting 180 million by 2022.
paragraphs.raw_text:
That is how we have reduced deforestation by 19 per cent in the past two years 
and continue to do so. Through the Artemis project, we are making our decision to 
turn diversity into a strategic asset a reality, and, accordingly, we have recovered 
more than 6,000 hectares of our Parques Nacionales Naturales and prevented 23,000

paragraphs.text: We have also made progress in the area of capacity-building to produce renewable energy in the fight against climate change. Whereas in 2018 we had 30 megawatts of capacity connected to the national grid, today we have expanded that capacity almost five-fold, reaching an additional 140 megawatts, with the goal of
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have also made progress in the area of capacity-building to produce 
renewable energy in the fight against climate change. Whereas in 2018 we had 
30 megawatts of capacity connected to the national grid, today we have expanded 
that capacity almost five-fold, reaching an additional 140 megawatts, with the goal of

paragraphs.text: continuing to increasing it 20-fold, in contrast to 2018, so that in 2022, our country will exceed 2,200 megawatts.
paragraphs.raw_text:
continuing to increasing it 20-fold, in contrast to 2018, so that in 2022, our country 
will exceed 2,200 megawatts.

paragraphs.text: We reaffirm our commitment to making the Minamata Convention on Mercury a reality, and we declare our progress as a nation in the adoption of a law banning the use of asbestos and in promoting the use of electric vehicles. Likewise, we are waiting for the Congress of the Republic to adopt the Regional Agreement on Access to Information, Public Participation and Justice in Environmental Matters in Latin America and the Caribbean, known as the Escazú Agreement, which we signed at the end of last year.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We reaffirm our commitment to making the Minamata Convention on Mercury 
a reality, and we declare our progress as a nation in the adoption of a law banning 
the use of asbestos and in promoting the use of electric vehicles. Likewise, we are 
waiting for the Congress of the Republic to adopt the Regional Agreement on Access 
to Information, Public Participation and Justice in Environmental Matters in Latin 
America and the Caribbean, known as the Escazú Agreement, which we signed at the 
end of last year.

paragraphs.text: The Leticia Pact, which I announced a year ago within the context of the General Assembly, has seen the realization of part of the call made by the Colombian Government, around which we have united seven States to implement a concrete action plan, which currently involves 52 specific actions for the conservation and sustainable development of the Amazon, while recognizing its importance as a strategic ecosystem for the planet.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Leticia Pact, which I announced a year ago within the context of the 
General Assembly, has seen the realization of part of the call made by the Colombian 
Government, around which we have united seven States to implement a concrete 
action plan, which currently involves 52 specific actions for the conservation and 
sustainable development of the Amazon, while recognizing its importance as a 
strategic ecosystem for the planet.

paragraphs.text: Colombia has succeeded in getting more than 2,800 families from the Amazon region to participate in livestock restructuring projects and the production of nontimber products. In addition, more than 17,000 indigenous families are benefiting from governance and sustainable economy projects, and 15,000 of them are beneficiaries of payment for environmental services mechanisms involving nearly 219,000 hectares. That demonstrates what we are achieving in imagining the future.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Colombia has succeeded in getting more than 2,800 families from the Amazon 
region to participate in livestock restructuring projects and the production of non-
timber products. In addition, more than 17,000 indigenous families are benefiting 
from governance and sustainable economy projects, and 15,000 of them are 
beneficiaries of payment for environmental services mechanisms involving nearly 
219,000 hectares. That demonstrates what we are achieving in imagining the future.

paragraphs.text: And just as we have led actions to protect the Amazon, the rainforests and the oceans, we call on all the nations of the planet to protect high-mountain ecosystems.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And just as we have led actions to protect the Amazon, the rainforests and the 
oceans, we call on all the nations of the planet to protect high-mountain ecosystems.

paragraphs.text: Colombia is home to half of the world’s páramos, and today I call on the members of the General Assembly to join us in creating a global strategy for safeguarding the high-altitude ecosystems to ensure their survival and the sustainability of the communities that inhabit them. The páramos are veritable drinking-water factories and the source of the watersheds that irrigate much of our country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Colombia is home to half of the world’s páramos, and today I call on the members 
of the General Assembly to join us in creating a global strategy for safeguarding 
the high-altitude ecosystems to ensure their survival and the sustainability of the 
communities that inhabit them. The páramos are veritable drinking-water factories 
and the source of the watersheds that irrigate much of our country.

paragraphs.text: Therefore, we also call on the nations of the world to contribute resources and understand that the protection of the páramos is a universal duty.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Therefore, we also call on the nations of the world to contribute resources and 
understand that the protection of the páramos is a universal duty.

paragraphs.text: Colombia is a magnificent country inhabited by men and women as diverse as its nature. We have lived through the onslaught of violence and poverty and are therefore committed to building a sustainable future based on equity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Colombia is a magnificent country inhabited by men and women as diverse 
as its nature. We have lived through the onslaught of violence and poverty and are 
therefore committed to building a sustainable future based on equity.

paragraphs.text: Achieving true peace is the social decision to build prosperity based on truth, solidarity, respect for law and the firm rejection of all forms of violence.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Achieving true peace is the social decision to build prosperity based on truth, 
solidarity, respect for law and the firm rejection of all forms of violence.

paragraphs.text: The Government has developed its Peace with Legality policy based on social stabilization and the institutional consolidation of the territories most historically affected by violence and poverty.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Government has developed its Peace with Legality policy based on social 
stabilization and the institutional consolidation of the territories most historically 
affected by violence and poverty.

paragraphs.text: The Peace with Legality policy is benefiting more than 6 million fellow citizens in their territories, with an investment of more than $780 million, supporting the more than 13,500 former combatants, as well as changing their lives — with a sense of legal purpose and guarantees of non-repetition for more than 9 million victims.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Peace with Legality policy is benefiting more than 6 million fellow citizens 
in their territories, with an investment of more than $780 million, supporting the 
more than 13,500 former combatants, as well as changing their lives — with a sense 
of legal purpose and guarantees of non-repetition for more than 9 million victims.

paragraphs.text: I would like to take the opportunity of being in this Hall to honour the victims of violence in my country. Likewise, I praise the work of those who every day make the million needed efforts into a reality — the social leaders who are building a
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to take the opportunity of being in this Hall to honour the victims 
of violence in my country. Likewise, I praise the work of those who every day make 
the million needed efforts into a reality  — the social leaders who are building a

paragraphs.text: more dignified and generous society, and who, despite the difficulties, are ceaseless in their efforts to build a country for all. We recognize their and all Colombians’ vocation to build a future by bridging and healing wounds, while, at the same time, ensuring that brotherhood under a reliable legal system gives us reason for pride.
paragraphs.raw_text:
more dignified and generous society, and who, despite the difficulties, are ceaseless 
in their efforts to build a country for all. We recognize their and all Colombians’ 
vocation to build a future by bridging and healing wounds, while, at the same time, 
ensuring that brotherhood under a reliable legal system gives us reason for pride.

paragraphs.text: Today in Colombia there are no conflicts between the friends and the enemies of peace. Today we are one country on the path moving forward regardless of whether the wind is with or against us.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Today in Colombia there are no conflicts between the friends and the enemies 
of peace. Today we are one country on the path moving forward regardless of whether 
the wind is with or against us.

paragraphs.text: Multilateral tools have been key to the international community’s contribution to that end, especially in terms of reparations for victims, strengthening rural development and formalizing property ownership in the remote corners of our country. I underscore and am grateful for the support of the United Nations Verification Mission in Colombia, which can exceptionally attest to the Government’s outstanding progress in achieving peace with legality, that is, real peace.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Multilateral tools have been key to the international community’s contribution 
to that end, especially in terms of reparations for victims, strengthening rural 
development and formalizing property ownership in the remote corners of our country. 
I underscore and am grateful for the support of the United Nations Verification 
Mission in Colombia, which can exceptionally attest to the Government’s outstanding 
progress in achieving peace with legality, that is, real peace.

paragraphs.text: Unfortunately, all our efforts face a common threat — drug trafficking and the illicit economies it generates. For my country, the fight against drug trafficking is an ethical imperative, as it produces all forms of corruption, comprises a ubiquitous link in crime and is the source of social decay.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Unfortunately, all our efforts face a common threat — drug trafficking and the 
illicit economies it generates. For my country, the fight against drug trafficking is an 
ethical imperative, as it produces all forms of corruption, comprises a ubiquitous link 
in crime and is the source of social decay.

paragraphs.text: Drug trafficking fuels human trafficking, arms trafficking, illegal mining, deforestation and smuggling. Drug trafficking tears families apart, breaches social values, constantly puts at risk the lives of millions of people around the world and fosters inequality, sowing hatred, violence and death in peaceful areas.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Drug trafficking fuels human trafficking, arms trafficking, illegal mining, 
deforestation and smuggling. Drug trafficking tears families apart, breaches social 
values, constantly puts at risk the lives of millions of people around the world and 
fosters inequality, sowing hatred, violence and death in peaceful areas.

paragraphs.text: Drug trafficking transcends borders, and my country has suffered as a victim because of this horrible fact. The transnational crime demands the joint action of all States, with a sense shared responsibility. In such shared challenges, we must act together, resolutely, energetically and unhesitatingly as a duty to future generations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Drug trafficking transcends borders, and my country has suffered as a victim 
because of this horrible fact. The transnational crime demands the joint action of all 
States, with a sense shared responsibility. In such shared challenges, we must act 
together, resolutely, energetically and unhesitatingly as a duty to future generations.

paragraphs.text: The situation caused by the coronavirus disease has also become a threat owing to the fissures caused by social inequalities.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The situation caused by the coronavirus disease has also become a threat 
owing to the fissures caused by social inequalities.

paragraphs.text: The global crisis has highlighted both the strengths and weaknesses of multilateral tools. For instance, it showed that the need remains to define better cooperation mechanisms in circumstances of crisis, while those same tools have led to the search for joint solutions to overcome it, for example, in terms of finding a vaccine.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The global crisis has highlighted both the strengths and weaknesses of 
multilateral tools. For instance, it showed that the need remains to define better 
cooperation mechanisms in circumstances of crisis, while those same tools have led 
to the search for joint solutions to overcome it, for example, in terms of finding 
a vaccine.

paragraphs.text: Working together with organizations such as the Pan-American Health Organization and the World Health Organization has been crucial throughout 2020 and will continue to be while we search for possible solutions to the crisis. Mechanisms, such as Vaccine Global Access, in which Colombia is actively participating, are essential to various nations’ collaboration in the search for and distribution of an eventual vaccine. Solidarity and sustained cooperation among nations are essential if we are to successfully weather the storm of the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Working together with organizations such as the Pan-American Health 
Organization and the World Health Organization has been crucial throughout 2020 and 
will continue to be while we search for possible solutions to the crisis. Mechanisms, 
such as Vaccine Global Access, in which Colombia is actively participating, are 
essential to various nations’ collaboration in the search for and distribution of an 
eventual vaccine. Solidarity and sustained cooperation among nations are essential if 
we are to successfully weather the storm of the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: The pandemic is proving to be a turning point in thinking about a sustainable and just future. Now that we are looking to revive our economies and restart leading productive lives, environmental sustainability needs to be the rallying point for building a more sustainable and responsible world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The pandemic is proving to be a turning point in thinking about a sustainable 
and just future. Now that we are looking to revive our economies and restart leading 
productive lives, environmental sustainability needs to be the rallying point for 
building a more sustainable and responsible world.

paragraphs.text: Within that framework, the protection of regional democracy is a fundamental element. The threats to democracy we see today are putting at risk the freedom of
paragraphs.raw_text:
Within that framework, the protection of regional democracy is a fundamental 
element. The threats to democracy we see today are putting at risk the freedom of

paragraphs.text: nations, as well as preventing regional integration and cooperation to overcome challenges like those currently facing humankind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
nations, as well as preventing regional integration and cooperation to overcome 
challenges like those currently facing humankind.

paragraphs.text: The Maduro regime is sustained by resources from drug trafficking, harbours terrorists and poses a constant threat to the democracies of the region and the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Maduro regime is sustained by resources from drug trafficking, harbours 
terrorists and poses a constant threat to the democracies of the region and the world.

paragraphs.text: The constant violations of human rights by the Maduro dictatorship, which we have condemned in our country and in international forums, including the International Criminal Court, have recently been confirmed by the United Nations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The constant violations of human rights by the Maduro dictatorship, which 
we have condemned in our country and in international forums, including the 
International Criminal Court, have recently been confirmed by the United Nations.

paragraphs.text: Why? The goal sought in Venezuela together with crimes against humanity is to perpetuate the tyranny. And the entire international community without exception must reject the situation, and we need to stridently call on all the nations of the world to raise their voices to demand truly free elections — not the staged electoral performance to which the Venezuelan people will be taken to in December only to perpetuate the dictatorship. We must, therefore, reject the process, which is seeking to legitimize Maduro’s dictatorship.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Why? The goal sought in Venezuela together with crimes against humanity is 
to perpetuate the tyranny. And the entire international community without exception 
must reject the situation, and we need to stridently call on all the nations of the 
world to raise their voices to demand truly free elections — not the staged electoral 
performance to which the Venezuelan people will be taken to in December only to 
perpetuate the dictatorship. We must, therefore, reject the process, which is seeking 
to legitimize Maduro’s dictatorship.

paragraphs.text: Colombia says to the world today that it looks to the future with optimism, with its head held high, and calls on its leaders to unite more so than ever, since the founding of the Organization, so that together we can overcome the unprecedented difficulties that these times have placed before us.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Colombia says to the world today that it looks to the future with optimism, 
with its head held high, and calls on its leaders to unite more so than ever, since the 
founding of the Organization, so that together we can overcome the unprecedented 
difficulties that these times have placed before us.

paragraphs.text: I am certain that our greatest strength lies in our own humanity. I am convinced that when we look back on these months, we will see resilient peoples, who stood up to the challenges of their time and navigated the storms wisely.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I am certain that our greatest strength lies in our own humanity. I am convinced 
that when we look back on these months, we will see resilient peoples, who stood up 
to the challenges of their time and navigated the storms wisely.

paragraphs.text: Presidents and Permanent Representatives, the future is in our hands.
paragraphs.raw_text: Presidents and Permanent Representatives, the future is in our hands.

paragraphs.text: Many thanks.
paragraphs.raw_text: Many thanks.
